diagnosis.plain_language: A post-infectious cough is a lingering cough that can continue for some weeks after a respiratory infection has otherwise settled.

medications.name: Levocetirizine
medications.purpose_plain: Levocetirizine is an antihistamine generally used to relieve allergy symptoms.

medications.name: Montelukast
medications.purpose_plain: Montelukast is a medicine generally used to help manage asthma and allergy-related symptoms.

follow_up: Review if not settling in 2 weeks.
